title: Make the order.paid handler idempotent
acceptanceCriteria: A publisher's retry of an event — same `eventId`, new `messageId` — books no second shipment and is acknowledged as `"duplicate"`, even after `CLAIM_TTL_MS` has passed
Two deliveries of one event arriving at the same time book exactly one shipment
When booking the shipment fails, the error reaches the broker and the redelivery books it
If a worker dies mid-delivery, a redelivery after `CLAIM_TTL_MS` books the shipment
A delivery that arrives while another is still booking the shipment returns `"retry-later"`; once the first is done, further deliveries return `"duplicate"`
